latest_features: Minimap pins now stay north-up with the map instead of rotating around the player yaw, so the map and markers hold a fixed orientation
ShulkMod2 now inherits the same access aliases as ShulkMod and SmithingSpam so stale policy naming cannot hide it from admin and vip users
The injector now honors C7_WORLD_PROXY_EXE before the managed helper cache so a custom world proxy build can override the pinned helper cleanly
Minimap rendering still keeps the stronger relief shading, configurable Nether slice view, and cleaner chest and player markers introduced in the previous release
